scene.heading: DMART'S STORES · JULY TO SEPTEMBER 2026
scene.note: DMART'S PRESS RELEASE AND PRESENTATION · 10 OCT 2026

say: And people kept coming. Stores open two years or more sold nine and a half percent more than a year ago. And across all its stores, D Mart rang up eleven point one crore bills in three months, up from nine point seven crore.
